methodology.nativeScope: trusted repository fixtures only; fresh owned temporary directories; fixed native executable argv; curated pipelines only
assertions: complete descendant file/directory map, bytes and mode
methodology.performanceClaim: None: one cold-to-warm correctness run, not a controlled throughput benchmark

oraclePolicy.decision: GNU sed 4.9 global-anchor substitution and invocation-wide successful quit; no claim of universal GNU/BSD utility or Bash compatibility
oraclePolicy.expectationSource: independently executed, immutable GNU sed 4.9 records, not virtual output
oraclePolicy.defaultOracle: live host /usr/bin/sed, /usr/bin/awk and curated pipelines; OS release and executable hashes recorded

liveNativeComparison.role: Unmodified live host comparison; BSD disagreement is not a GNU failure or a reclassified unsupported feature

cases.name: sed-branch-test-reset
args:
s/a/b/;t first
b done
:first
t wrong
p;b done
:wrong
s/.*/WRONG/;p
:done

cases.name: awk-array-membership-delete
args: BEGIN{a["x"]=3;print ("x" in a),("y" in a);delete a["x"];print ("x" in a)}

cases.name: awk-function-local-extra-parameter
args: function f(x, temp){temp=x+1;return temp} BEGIN{temp=99;print f(3),temp}

cases.name: pipeline-sed-awk-aggregate
cases.script: sed 's/:/ /g' | awk '{sum[$1]+=$2} END{print sum["a"],sum["b"]}' | tee output
